selection: Trial005 preserves all trial004 HIMBO/3BA numerical gains and caps. It extends the same TorsoGirth output cap to CBBE because that family uses the same female wolf geometry; its gains are normalized to preserve the original sub-cap slope. This is cap consistency, not new CBBE calibration or acceptance. Trial004 selected belly/girth through exact finite regional MAD with primary-direction, individual-RMS and waist-depth constraints; geometry quality limits take precedence over proportional fit.

primaryWaistCounterEvidence.selectionPriority: Primary-direction correctness precedes equal-axis torsoRMS; 6of25 heldout torsoRMS regressions per endpoint are retained.

finiteMetric.regions: Frozen neutral bone-weight memberships>=0.25; waist/midtorso/chest/hip width/depth scored equally. q05-95 span and full span reported separately.
finiteMetric.qualityConstraint: TorsoGirth output <= 0.25 for HIMBO, 3BA and CBBE. Gains normalize by oldCap/newCap so the intended sub-cap linear multiplier is preserved. The bound is provisional, not proof of all joint shapes.
finiteMetric.limits: Exact for summed serialized neutral fields, not posed live vertices or visual acceptance. Firstorder features remain surrogate only. Runa worst hip-depth error rises0.161pp despite tiny torsoRMS improvement; Grom waist width underfits by23.04pp because safer Girth cannot supply the human width.
